entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your full name and order number?
Of course. It's Amelia Vance. The order number should be VF78-PULSE-9012.

Thank you, Amelia. I see your account here. You've been with us for quite a while, we appreciate your loyalty. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse about 15 days ago. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... it's not what I expected. And honestly, with the holidays just passing, things are a little tight. I really needed this money back. I was so excited for it, but I feel awful that I can't justify keeping it.
I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your VeloFit products. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I review the return eligibility for your order.

Thank you for your patience, Amelia. I've double-checked our system, and it looks like our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 15 days ago, you're well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried it would be too late.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just package the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That's wonderful. You have no idea how much this helps. I really do love your products, this one just wasn't the right fit.

I'm glad we could sort it out. And because you're a valued VIP member, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account. You can use it on any future VeloFit purchase within the next six months. Hopefully, you can find something that's a better fit for you down the road.
Wow, you didn't have to do that! Thank you, Isaac. That's really kind. You've been incredibly helpful.
It's my pleasure, Amelia. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
